products.name: Supplier Suite
products.description: Eneve's Supplier Suite: the order-to-cash backbone of an energy supplier in four solutions of the Ecedo and Gridhub heritage. Customer Onboarding: automated intake, identity and credit checks, activation, and switching and move-in through EDSN and the central connection register (C-AR). Contract & Billing: one contracts and connections register for every contract and product type (fixed, variable, dynamic, EV, battery, bundled, complex B2B multi-site agreements), automated billing runs with VAT, guarantees of origin and split invoicing on smart-meter, telemetry and clustered data, reconciliation and exception handling, direct debit, payment matching, payment plans and dunning. Customer Interfacing: customer lifecycle and touchpoints, case management and communication (the white-label portal is sold as its own product). Sourcing & Pricing: dynamic pricing and procurement tools, position tracking and portfolio forecasting for suppliers that source their own portfolio. Subscription per supplier, scaling with connections and modules; Eneve's supplier customers include Eneco, Essent, Engie, Vattenfall, Mega, Vandebron, Scholt Energie, Pure Energie and PZEM.

products.name: Proposition Launch Studio
products.description: Low-code proposition builder ("From idea to live product. In weeks.") sold as an add-on to the Supplier Suite and the Iberian platform. Commercial teams configure products and tariffs (fixed, variable, dynamic spot, EV time-of-use, battery, capacity-linked, bundled), pricing logic and price-curve links, sign-up journeys, campaigns and sales-channel availability, and B2B cost-plus quoting rules without a development project. Each configured proposition plugs into the contracts register, billing runs, portal and market communication automatically, so a product that used to take eighteen months goes live in weeks and bills correctly from the first invoice.

products.name: White-Label Customer Portal and App
products.description: White-label web portal and iOS/Android app that suppliers offer to households and business customers under their own brand: invoice breakdown, consumption history and projected costs on the same meter data that drives billing, tariff and contract changes, meter readings, payment-method, direct-debit and payment-plan changes, disputes and service requests, and lifecycle messages from welcome to final settlement. Portal, billing and settlement share one data model, so customers see what they are billed for and service leads cut contact rate per connection. Delivered with the Supplier Suite and the Iberian platform; Eneve's Dutch supplier clients serve 7M+ households and 3M+ business customers. Free for the end customer, paid by the supplier.

products.name: Balancing and Shipping Suite
products.description: Eneve's Balancing & Shipping Suite, the Energy21 EBASE heritage (BRP market messages since 2002), in three solutions. Balancing & Shipping: meter data collection and validation from smart meters, telemetry and clustered data (Eneve's software validates over 90% of Dutch consumption data); allocation and reconciliation under Allocation 2.0 including the TenneT MMC-Hub exchange for SMA and TMT connections; day-ahead, intraday and ex-post forecasting; automated nominations, re-nominations and position management for electricity (TenneT) and gas (GTS), including the gas trading and shipping agreed with EBN in September 2024. Intraday Steering: real-time and solar-optimised steering signals on near real-time positions. BRP as a Service: the same engines operated by Eneve, sold separately as a managed service. Priced per portfolio for BRPs, shippers and supplier portfolio desks, with 15-minute financial insight per segment.

products.name: BRP as a Service
products.description: Fully managed balance responsibility on the Balancing & Shipping Suite, with Eneve carrying the BRP market role on the customer's behalf and its operations desk running the cycle: day-ahead, intraday and ex-post forecasting, TenneT nominations and re-nominations, ETPA intraday trading as a guaranteed cycle, allocation, imbalance management, reconciliation and settlement for all EAN types including BSP and flex assets. Portfolios from 40 GWh on tiered MWh pricing; the customer keeps commercial control and 15-minute financial insight while Eneve carries the shifts and market-communication compliance. Eneve reports up to 53% lower imbalance costs. For new entrants it removes the need to build a balancing desk before the first customer; for established suppliers it turns balance responsibility into a per-MWh cost.

products.name: Trade and Portfolio Suite
products.description: Eneve's Trade & Portfolio Suite (Jules heritage) with the sourcing and risk tooling of a portfolio desk: sourcing, hedging and procurement against the portfolio forecast; price curves from EPEX Spot (15-minute Dutch day-ahead since 30 September 2025), OMIE and forward markets; position, volume, value and risk per segment per 15 minutes ("Track positions, spot risks, take action"); cost-plus pricing and B2B deal structuring; and Customer Trading, the desk through which business customers such as BASF and USG Chemelot execute click trades within their framework contract, manage forecasts and analyse consumption per site. Sold per portfolio to supplier desks, traders and BRPs in the Netherlands and the UK; Eneve's customer list includes Axpo and TotalEnergies.

products.name: Nemon Trade Energy for Spain and Portugal
products.description: The Nemon products acquired on 30 March 2026 (Trade Energy, Trade Energy CRM and Trade Energy SIPS), used by about 100 supplier customers in Spain and Portugal including Barcelona Energia: intake, contracts and supply points (CUPS), billing with access tariffs, regulated components and Spanish and Portuguese taxes, SEPA collections and debtor management, CRM case handling and documents, and Iberian market communication (SIPS supply-point queries, CNMC-format ATR files with distributors, OMIE prices, REE settlement and measurement data). Kept running under the Eneve brand while identity, portal, dashboards and integration converge on the shared foundation, so the Proposition Launch Studio, the white-label portal and the Trade & Portfolio Suite can be cross-sold to Iberian suppliers.

products.name: Market Entry and Expertise Services
products.description: Eneve's expertise services. Energy Market Enablement: a market-entry scan for the Netherlands and Spain (regulatory scan, competitive overview, operating model, commercial blueprint and roadmap; five workstreams in five weeks) and licensing support (ACM 8-14 weeks, CNMC 12-20 weeks, dual entry 16-20 weeks) against the six-month-plus ramp most entrants underestimate. Customer Services: implementation, migration of Ecedo, Energy21, Jules, Gridhub and Nemon customers onto the consolidated platform, strategy guidance and ongoing support. Eneve Academy: training for commercial, billing, service and portfolio teams. Delivered by the market-enablement and customer-success teams with the platform's migration, dashboard and compliance tooling.

products.name: Open API and Integration Connectors
products.description: Connectivity add-on across suites: an open REST API with per-tenant credentials, scopes, webhooks and developer documentation, plus the certified connector catalogue: Dutch market messaging (EDSN, C-AR, TenneT MMC-Hub), TenneT and GTS nomination interfaces, ETPA, Iberian OMIE, REE, SIPS and distributor files, ERP and accounting packages, payment and SEPA direct-debit providers, smart-meter and telemetry data providers, and price and weather feeds. Suppliers and BRPs keep their finance, CRM and asset tooling while the platform stays the system of record for connections, contracts, volumes, nominations, invoices and payments; Eneve maintains the connectors as market rules change.
